title: Momentic: AI Testing Platform Review (2026 Guide)
summary: Momentic is an AI testing tool for automation teams. Find out what the product offers and when the tool launched.
body_markdown:
## Connect momentic without native support


Until you have a quote and a billing unit, you also have no integration to lean on. Activepieces has shipped nothing specific to momentic: none of the 746 integrations counted in` packages/pieces/community` in its repository is named for it.


We haven't run momentic ourselves either, so what follows is built from the maker's pages and the generic steps any workflow tool offers. The three options below run from simplest to most involved, and each has one condition that must hold first.


### Connect momentic with an HTTP request step


This is the plainest route: a workflow step that sends a request to an address you give it. The condition is that momentic exposes an endpoint you can call to start a run or read a result.


[momentic.ai](https://momentic.ai/) describes Mo as an AI QA engineer that tests your app end to end from a prompt, but a product description isn't an API reference.


Find the documented endpoint, its authentication method and its response fields before you map anything. If you can't find them, this option is closed.


### Connect momentic through an AI step custom provider


When an AI step runs, it sends a prompt to a language model and returns text. A custom or OpenAI-compatible provider setting lets you point that step at a different address than the default vendor.


The condition is that momentic serves a model endpoint that speaks that request format.


Nothing we have read says it does. Momentic's` extract` command, which[reads a value from the page](https://momentic.ai/docs/reference/commands/extract) , runs inside a test and isn't a chat endpoint. So treat this as a possibility to verify, not an assumption.


### Connect momentic through an MCP server


MCP, the Model Context Protocol, lets an AI agent call outside tools through a server. The condition is that momentic, or someone you trust, publishes such a server, and that your workflow tool can act as a client for it.


Without both, there's nothing to connect.


If both hold, this route gives an agent the most freedom, and it also demands the most review of what the agent may trigger.


The agent side is the part Activepieces already has in place.


Each of the 746 integrations in` packages/pieces/community` in the MIT-licensed repository is a integration, and the action that runs as a step in a flow is the same one the per-project MCP server exposes as a tool schema, reachable from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or an agent you built, so you don't need to write 746 custom connectors.


The Integrations Framework and MCP Server documentation describe that mechanism, and` packages/pieces` in the open source repo holds the single action definition behind both. So if a Momentic integration ever lands there, it serves your flows and your agents at once, with no second integration.


MoneyGram, Moneypenny, Alan and FundingSocieties run Activepieces in production.
